title: Instagram Follower Counter v2
description: Fetches follower counts for Instagram usernames using multiple session rotation. No browser needed — pure HTTP with automatic session switching on rate limits.

usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: Instagram usernames to look up. Do not include the @ symbol.

sessions.title: Instagram Sessions
sessions.description:
One entry per Instagram account you own. The actor rotates through them automatically — when one gets rate limited, it switches to the next.

How to get sessionId + csrfToken:
1. Log in to Instagram in Chrome
2. Open DevTools → Application → Cookies → https://www.instagram.com
3. Copy 'sessionid' and 'csrftoken' values

Format:
[
  { "sessionId": "abc123", "csrfToken": "xyz789" },
  { "sessionId": "def456", "csrfToken": "uvw012" }
]

More sessions = faster runs and less downtime from rate limits.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of parallel requests. Default 5 is safe. With 3+ sessions you can raise to 10–15. Too high risks faster rate limiting.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies strongly recommended. Each session uses a consistent proxy URL to avoid IP-session mismatch.
